ignoreCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; PREFIX="$(git rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -n "$PREFIX" ]; then TARGET_PREFIX="$PREFIX"; else TARGET_PREFIX="apps/docs-site/"; fi; if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA"^{commit} 2>/dev/null && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA"^{commit} 2>/dev/null; then RANGE="$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA $VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA"; elif git rev-parse --verify HEAD^ >/dev/null 2>&1; then RANGE="HEAD^ HEAD"; else exit 1; fi; if git diff --name-only $RANGE | grep -Eq "^${TARGET_PREFIX}"; then exit 1; fi; exit 0'
